title: Owning the 111 Dance Hall building
summary: Garland says he owned the building and led the band there for about ten years.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yes, well that's where I heard him and Duke wrote a beautiful portrait of Wellman Braud after -- the New Orleans suite, it's very, very beautiful. A beautiful piece. So, then we have Ed Garland the band leader and the 111 Dancehall in Los Angeles, and you worked there for a long time --
Oh, me, I owned the building.
So, how many years were you there, Tudi Toetie?
I was supposed to be there around 10 years.
10 years. Sounds like the beginning of steady job. That's great and then, after that what --
